entries.title: Psalms 70:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David; ato bring to remembrance.>> [Make haste], O God, to deliver me; Make haste to help me, O Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 70:2
segments: Let them be put to shame and confounded That seek after my soul: Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor That delight in my hurt.

entries.title: Psalms 70:3
segments: Let them be turned back by reason of their shame That say, Aha, aha.

entries.title: Psalms 70:4
segments: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee; And let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

entries.title: Psalms 70:5
segments: But I am poor and needy; Make haste unto me, O God: Thou art my help and my deliverer; O Jehovah, make no tarrying.
